subject: MedVantage security intake call — SOC 2 / CAIQ / evidence plan
messages:

Cc: security@medvantage.com

Subject: Request to schedule SOC 2 / CAIQ intake and share initial SIG

Hi Evelyn / Laura,

Thanks for the fast responses in our procurement tracker. We're ready to run an intake for SOC 2 and the CAIQ/SIG matrix for our pilot integration. We'd like to schedule a ~45 minute call this week to: 1) review the questionnaire mapping, 2) confirm evidence handoff format and owners, and 3) agree on timelines for the SOC 2 snapshot and the CAIQ.

Suggested windows (PST):
- Wed 2026-06-16 10:00-11:00 or 14:00-14:45
- Thu 2026-06-17 09:00-09:45 or 15:00-15:45

I've attached our initial SIG spreadsheet with the sections we'd like to focus on (network segmentation, data retention, and access control). For the call, can you share a recent SOC 2 snapshot or an SSP extract and any preferred evidence formats (PDF/Drive links/zip)?

Attachment: medvantage_initial_sig_questions.xlsx (partial answers included)

Thanks,
Sam Fillmore
Director, Information Security
MedVantage Health
sam.fillmore@medvantage.com

Hi Sam / Alice — great to meet you. Thanks for sending the spreadsheet. We're available for the Thu 15:00-15:45 PST slot and will use that time to align on owners and artifacts.

Proposed agenda (45 min):
- 5m introductions and scope (Redwood + MedVantage owners)
- 10m walk through the SIG rows you flagged (network, retention, access)
- 15m evidence formats and handoff process (Drive folder, naming conventions)
- 10m timeline and next steps (who provides what and when)
- 5m Q&A and open items

We'll bring: a recent SOC 2 snapshot (redwood-soc2-snapshot-2026-05.pdf), a short extract of our SSP mapping, and a network diagram. Marcus will be on the call to answer architecture questions; Aditya will cover our evidence transfer and encryption details.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=INTAKE
Call time: Thu 2026-06-17 15:00 PST / 18:00 EST

See you then — please confirm and add any items you want covered.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Security Engagements

Evelyn — confirmed for Thu 15:00 PST. One ask: please make sure we get a network architecture diagram that shows segmentation between customer data stores and Redwood processing nodes; that will help our security team validate controls quickly.

Also would you be able to call out any third-party subprocessors (cloud providers / CDN / analytics)? If you can include short notes in the Drive folder ahead of the meeting that would be helpful.

Thanks,

Date: 2026-06-17T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Notes and action items — intake call (Thu 2026-06-17)

Hi Sam / Alice — thanks again for the call earlier today. Below are concise notes and agreed next steps. I've included the exact owners and target dates so it's easy to track.

Meeting notes (summary):
- Attendees: Sam (MedVantage InfoSec), Alice (Procurement), Evelyn / Aditya / Marcus / Laura (Redwood)
- Scope: SOC 2 snapshot review, CAIQ mapping for data handling, SIG clarifications on network & retention
- Key clarifications: Redwood retains customer content in encrypted object storage; short-term caches are ephemeral (<24h) and not persisted to backups. We confirmed the expected retention window and masking practices.
- Third parties: Primary cloud provider: Redwood Cloud (managed provider), CDN: Fastedge, analytics: internal telemetry (no PII persisted) — Aditya to provide the subprocessors list as a CSV.

Action items (owner — due):
1) Aditya Rao — provide subprocessors list (cloud/CDN/analytics) + encryption-at-rest details — due 2026-06-19
2) Marcus Lin — export and drop a high-level network diagram into the shared Drive (network-arch-diagram.png) — due 2026-06-19
3) Laura Bennett — upload SOC 2 snapshot extract (redwood-soc2-snapshot-2026-05.pdf) and an SSP extract into Drive and post link — due 2026-06-18
4) Sam / MedVantage — mark any SIG rows requiring evidence collection and tag owners in the spreadsheet — due 2026-06-22

Attachments uploaded to drive folder: redwood-soc2-snapshot-2026-05.pdf (partial), network-arch-diagram.png (draft) — link below.
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_medvantage_intake

Notes: We will accept evidence as Drive links or zipped PDFs. For any items requiring signatures (BAA/contract addendum), Alice, we can send a DocuSign link — I will coordinate with your procurement team once the evidence set is scoped.

Thanks everyone,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Security Engagements
